change: ServiceTitan posted 12 Account Executive roles aimed at residential contractors with under 20 techs.
whyItMatters: Points to a push into our core segment over the next two quarters. Expect them in more 5 to 20 tech deals.
whatToSay: No talk track yet. FYI for sales leadership and territory planning.

change: Jobber published a 'switching from Housecall Pro' guide with a migration checklist.
whyItMatters: Jobber is going after our customers directly. CS will hear about it first, at renewal.
whatToSay: "Switching is always possible. Before you weigh it, let's look at what you'd give up, like marketing and financing in one place."

change: Long onboarding and contract terms are a recurring theme in public reviews of ServiceTitan this quarter (summarized theme, not a single review).
whyItMatters: Speed to go live is our clearest proof point against ServiceTitan. Back it with our own onboarding data.
whatToSay: "How long did they quote you for setup, and who on your team runs it while you're still booking jobs?"

change: Two closed-lost notes this month say the owner chose ServiceTitan because 'we'll grow into it.'
whyItMatters: Owners may be picking ServiceTitan for how big it looks. Reps need to test the growth plan early.
whatToSay: "What does your team look like in 18 months? Let's price both options for that team."

change: Jobber launched an AI receptionist that answers calls and books jobs straight into the schedule.
whyItMatters: After-hours calls are a top pain for the office. Prospects will ask whether we do the same, often on the first call.
whatToSay: "Ask what happens when it can't fit a job, and who sees that call. Then let's look at how missed calls reach your office today."

change: ServiceTitan's blog now features posts aimed at owners with 5 to 20 techs, including one on getting running in 30 days.
whyItMatters: ServiceTitan is speaking to our core buyer and taking aim at its own weak spot, the long setup.
whatToSay: "Thirty days is their goal for a fast start. Ask what that month looks like for your office while you're still running jobs."

change: Jobber mentions on SDR calls with lawn care and cleaning companies rose for the third straight week.
whyItMatters: Jobber shows up earliest in these trades. SDRs need a quick, fair answer ready on the first call.
whatToSay: "Lots of shops start on Jobber. What would you need to add if you hired two more people this spring?"

change: Jobber added a consumer financing partner to its app marketplace.
whyItMatters: Narrows one of our differentiators. Financing is still a separate app for them, but the gap is smaller.
whatToSay: "Ask whether financing lives in the same quote the tech shows the customer, or in another app."

change: Jobber moved online booking from its Connect plan down to its entry Core plan.
whyItMatters: Removes a gap we used in price conversations. Owners comparing entry plans will now see booking on both sides.
whatToSay: "Good, booking matters. Compare the plan you'll need with two more techs, marketing and financing included."

change: Jobber's 'vs. Housecall Pro' page now claims a lower total monthly cost for a 10-person team and no add-on fees for online booking.
whyItMatters: Prospects will quote this page in price conversations. Our own comparison page needs an answer this week.
whatToSay: "Their math counts today's plan. Let's put both side by side for the same features, at the team size you're hiring toward."

change: ServiceTitan's release notes announce a guided 30-day onboarding package for shops under 20 techs.
whyItMatters: Takes aim at our best proof point against them, speed to go live. Expect it in deals with growing HVAC and plumbing shops.
whatToSay: "Thirty days is a real improvement. Ask what the office does during that month, and what the contract term is after it."

change: ServiceTitan's earnings commentary called out growth with smaller residential contractors as a priority.
whyItMatters: Confirms the hiring and blog signals. This looks like a lasting strategy shift.
whatToSay: No rep talk track. Goes to leadership in this week's So what.

change: Jobber posted several payments and lending roles.
whyItMatters: Hints at deeper payments and financing work over the next year.
whatToSay: No talk track. FYI for Product.
